fixtures.source: Same mulberry32 generator/seed/scale and durations as bench/benchmark.ts for 3s mono and 5s stereo; PCM16 quantization for real files. 60s is an added scaling workload.

method: Actual installed pinned VSIX packages; separate fresh VS Code profiles with other competing plugins disabled; unchanged production code, original file IPC and codecs. First open separate; each warm workload closes/recreates its webview, three trials. Ready requires native metadata and visible chart state plus two RAFs. EAR/STFT and upstream Analyze are selected through their real UI. Default analysis/render settings differ across plugins; these are workflow timings, not equal-FFT rankings. Audio output muted only in the test process.
memoryBoundary: V8 Runtime.getHeapUsage after GC for webview renderer isolate; includes its retained buffers, not whole-editor peak RAM. TaskDuration excludes Worker/host processes. Browser/native cache is not cold-reset between files.
